title: Clean Code & SOLID
description: Clean code, naming, functions, errors, KISS / DRY / YAGNI, refactoring, Clean Architecture, and all five SOLID principles with practical examples.

title: Design Patterns
description: The 22 classic Gang of Four patterns in three families (creational, structural, behavioral), explained with real-life analogies and short JavaScript examples.

title: Software Architecture
description: Layered, MVC/MVVM, Clean Architecture, Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters), Onion, Domain-Driven Design, event-driven, microkernel, serverless, vertical slices and the modular monolith, plus how to choose between them.

title: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Big-O, arrays, hash maps, linked lists, stacks, trees, heaps, graphs, sorting, binary search, recursion and dynamic programming, with a pattern cheat sheet for interviews.

title: Backend Engineering
description: How requests travel, API design (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), SQL vs NoSQL, indexing, caching with Redis, queues, authentication, scaling, Docker and backend languages.

title: Frontend Engineering
description: How browsers render, the JavaScript event loop, TypeScript, React and hooks, state management, Next.js rendering modes, performance, security and testing.

title: Microservices
description: Monolith vs microservices, service boundaries, sync vs async communication, API gateways, resilience patterns, sagas, the outbox pattern, CQRS and observability.

title: Apache Kafka
description: Topics, partitions and offsets, producers, consumer groups, replication, delivery guarantees, and when to choose Kafka over RabbitMQ.

title: Kubernetes
description: From first Pod to production: cluster architecture, Deployments, Services and Ingress, storage, probes and Helm, then StatefulSets, Jobs, scheduling, networking and NetworkPolicies, troubleshooting, RBAC and security, CRDs and operators, GitOps, observability, upgrades and interview questions.

title: AWS for Developers
tagline: Build, deploy and secure cloud applications
description: A complete AWS path for developers: global infrastructure, IAM and least privilege, VPC networking, EC2 and Auto Scaling, load balancers and Route 53, S3, CloudFront, ECS on Fargate, RDS, Aurora and DynamoDB, Lambda and API Gateway, SQS/SNS/EventBridge, Cognito, Secrets Manager and KMS, CloudWatch observability, CI/CD with IaC, data pipelines and interview questions.

title: Programming Languages
tagline: Write code with the right tools and mental models
description: JavaScript fundamentals and async code, TypeScript in practice, Node.js with Express and NestJS, Python with FastAPI and Django, Go with goroutines and Gin, and Rust ownership, traits and concurrency, plus how to choose a language.

title: System Design L6
tagline: Design for scale, failure and recovery
description: Staff-level system-design case studies: define correctness, find bottlenecks, recover safely and limit blast radius.

title: Database Design & Performance
tagline: Model data, protect correctness, scale reads and writes
description: Relational modeling, normalization, ACID, indexes, query performance, replication, sharding, storage engines, and detailed DBMS interview preparation.
